traceability.notes: All requirements and acceptance criteria from docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md are implemented and verified via tests:,- File-level @supports template insertion (REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE / PLACEHOLDER / SAFE / PRESERVE / NO-INFERENCE) is implemented in buildSupportsTemplateComment, insertSupportsTemplate, and ensureFileSupportsAnnotation, with RuleTester tests confirming exact before/after output.,- Malformed `[REQ-XXX]` prefix normalization (REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT / SAFE / PRESERVE / NO-INFERENCE) is implemented in normalizeReqId, normalizeReqPrefixInDescription, and handleItOrTestCall; tests cover spacing, underscores, lowercase, and parentheses, and also verify that correct prefixes are not changed.,- Safety constraints are respected: fixes only touch comments and string literals, never infer story paths or REQ IDs, and only emit fixes when normalization is unambiguous; otherwise the rule reports an error with no fixer (e.g., missing prefix case).,- Integration with ESLint --fix is correct: the rule is a standard RuleModule with meta.fixable = 'code', uses ESLint fixer APIs, and is wired into the plugin and documented in the user API reference.,- Documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md explicitly documents autoFixTestTemplate, autoFixTestPrefixFormat, and testSupportsTemplate, including the placeholder template behavior and safety constraints, satisfying the story’s documentation requirement.,- The dedicated test suite `tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts` is explicitly annotated as supporting this story and all its requirement IDs, and the full Jest test run passes.
